simple.meaning: יְאִתוֹן (yᵉʼithôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “an entry.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יְאִתוֹן (H2978) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezekiel 40:15, with occurrences in Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יְאִתוֹן (H2978) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יְאִתוֹן (H2978) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יְאִתוֹן (yᵉʼithôwn) / H2978 is traced through Ezekiel 40:15 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
